    print(f"n = {n}, s_max = {s_max}")

def check_s(n, s):
    # The condition for the existence of a strategy is n >= 2^s.
    return n >= 2**s

n = 4096
print(f"n={n}, s=12: {check_s(n, 12)}")
print(f"n={n}, s=13: {check_s(n, 13)}")
print(f"n={n}, s=2048: {check_s(n, 2048)}")
print(f"n={n}, s=1: {check_s(n, 1)}")
